recent.text: I will add to Charlie's commentary that I expect Barkey will be a career overachiever if he stays healthy. To me, it's not really the raw numbers but how and when he will step up.

recent.quoted_text: I'm not saying that Barkey has star-level upside. That was never the expectation. But I am saying that if a player who WAS perceived to have star-level upside was putting up these kinds of results in his first full NHL season, there'd be a ton of excitement around him.
